cases.source:

.repeat VALUE, INDEX
.byte INDEX,.ref(VALUE)

run

cases.name: repeat_forward_macro
cases.source:
.macro run
VALUE=2
.repeat .const(LATER), INDEX
.byte INDEX,.ref(VALUE)
.endrepeat
.byte .ref(VALUE)
LATER=2
.endmacro
run
